description: This file defines a template class 'BaseOperationalType' for managing operational stream categories within the Thunder namespace. It includes macros for defining categories and provides static methods for controlling and querying the state of operational categories such as 'StandardOut' and 'StandardError'. The file also includes licensing information and dependencies on other modules.

classes.name: BaseOperationalType
classes.description: A template class that manages operational stream categories, providing static methods to control and access category properties.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method that calls IsEnabled() to possibly announce the category.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton reference to the Control object managing the category.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the category is enabled.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the category based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the category instance.
